submission_contract: one read-only SELECT statement per lovable query_database call

queries.sql: SELECT current_database() AS database_name, current_user AS database_role, current_setting('server_version') AS postgres_version, to_regprocedure('extensions.digest(bytea,text)') IS NOT NULL AS sha256_digest_available, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron') AS pg_cron_available

SELECT count(*)::integer AS ledger_count, max(version) AS ledger_tip, encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(string_agg(version || E'\x1f' || COALESCE(name, '<NULL>') || E'\x1f' || cardinality(statements)::text || E'\x1f' || encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(COALESCE(array_to_string(statements, E'\x1e'), ''), 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex'), E'\x1d' ORDER BY version), 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex') AS ledger_fingerprint_sha256, count(*) FILTER (WHERE version = '20260128005316')::integer AS hosted_only_marker_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE version = '20260802043233')::integer AS canonical_version_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE version > '20260802043233')::integer AS post_canonical_rows FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations

SELECT to_regclass('tenant_security.release_provenance') IS NOT NULL AS provenance_table_present, encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(string_agg(column_name || ':' || data_type || ':' || is_nullable, ',' ORDER BY ordinal_position), 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex') AS column_signature_sha256, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = to_regclass('tenant_security.release_provenance') AND tgname = 'release_provenance_append_only' AND tgenabled = 'O' AND NOT tgisinternal)::integer AS enabled_append_only_trigger_rows, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) = 'postgres' AS owned_by_postgres, NOT has_table_privilege('anon', 'tenant_security.release_provenance', 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') AND NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'tenant_security.release_provenance', 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') AND NOT has_table_privilege('service_role', 'tenant_security.release_provenance', 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') AS api_roles_have_no_table_dml, (SELECT count(*) FROM tenant_security.release_provenance WHERE release_id = 'voice-artifact-retention-lovable-v1')::integer AS target_provenance_rows FROM information_schema.columns AS cols CROSS JOIN pg_class AS c WHERE cols.table_schema = 'tenant_security' AND cols.table_name = 'release_provenance' AND c.oid = to_regclass('tenant_security.release_provenance') GROUP BY c.relowner

SELECT encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(string_agg(contype::text || ':' || pg_get_constraintdef(oid, false), E'\x1d' ORDER BY contype::text, pg_get_constraintdef(oid, false)), 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex') AS provenance_constraint_signature_sha256, (SELECT encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(string_agg(a.attname || ':' || pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid), E'\x1d' ORDER BY a.attname), 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex') FROM pg_attrdef AS d INNER JOIN pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid = d.adrelid AND a.attnum = d.adnum WHERE d.adrelid = 'tenant_security.release_provenance'::regclass) AS provenance_default_signature_sha256 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'tenant_security.release_provenance'::regclass

SELECT (to_regclass('private.voice_artifact_purge_runs') IS NOT NULL)::integer + (to_regprocedure('private.try_parse_voice_retention_deadline(text)') IS NOT NULL)::integer + (to_regprocedure('private.purge_expired_voice_artifact_batch(integer,uuid)') IS NOT NULL)::integer + (to_regclass('public.chat_messages_voice_retention_due_idx') IS NOT NULL)::integer AS retention_objects_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = 'bluladder-voice-artifact-retention-purge')::integer AS exact_name_jobs, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_locks WHERE relation = 'public.chat_messages'::regclass AND granted AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND mode IN ('RowExclusiveLock','ShareUpdateExclusiveLock','ShareLock','ShareRowExclusiveLock','ExclusiveLock','AccessExclusiveLock'))::integer AS conflicting_chat_message_locks, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database() AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND xact_start < clock_timestamp() - interval '5 minutes')::integer AS transactions_open_over_five_minutes

SELECT to_regnamespace('private') IS NOT NULL AS private_schema_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job WHERE command ~* 'purge_expired_voice_artifact_batch')::integer AS purge_command_jobs, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = 'tenant_security.release_provenance'::regclass AND tgname = 'release_provenance_append_only' AND tgenabled = 'O' AND NOT tgisinternal AND tgtype = 27 AND tgfoid = 'tenant_security.reject_release_provenance_mutation()'::regprocedure)::integer AS exact_append_only_trigger_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'tenant_security.release_provenance'::regclass AND contype = 'p' AND conkey = ARRAY[(SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = 'tenant_security.release_provenance'::regclass AND attname = 'release_id')]::smallint[])::integer AS exact_provenance_primary_keys, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'tenant_security.release_provenance'::regclass AND contype = 'c')::integer AS provenance_check_constraints, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attrdef WHERE adrelid = 'tenant_security.release_provenance'::regclass)::integer AS provenance_defaults, (SELECT pg_get_userbyid(proowner) = 'postgres' AND NOT prosecdef AND proconfig = ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog']::text[] AND btrim(regexp_replace(prosrc, '\s+', ' ', 'g')) = 'BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION ''release provenance is append-only''; END' FROM pg_proc WHERE oid = 'tenant_security.reject_release_provenance_mutation()'::regprocedure) AS exact_rejection_function, NOT has_function_privilege('anon', 'tenant_security.reject_release_provenance_mutation()', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'tenant_security.reject_release_provenance_mutation()', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('service_role', 'tenant_security.reject_release_provenance_mutation()', 'EXECUTE') AS rejection_function_private, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE confrelid = 'public.chat_messages'::regclass)::integer AS inbound_chat_message_foreign_keys, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = 'public.chat_messages'::regclass AND NOT tgisinternal AND (tgtype & 8) = 8)::integer AS chat_message_delete_triggers, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_rewrite WHERE ev_class = 'public.chat_messages'::regclass AND ev_type = '4')::integer AS chat_message_delete_rules

SELECT to_regclass('public.chat_messages') IS NOT NULL AS chat_messages_present, to_regclass('public.chat_conversations') IS NOT NULL AS chat_conversations_present, count(*) FILTER (WHERE table_name = 'chat_messages' AND column_name = 'ai_metadata' AND data_type = 'jsonb')::integer AS ai_metadata_columns, count(*) FILTER (WHERE table_name = 'chat_conversations' AND column_name IN ('organization_id','channel','session_token'))::integer AS conversation_authority_columns FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('chat_messages','chat_conversations')

SELECT count(*)::integer AS total_chat_messages_examined, count(*) FILTER (WHERE canonical_artifact AND retention_deadline <= clock_timestamp())::integer AS canonical_expired_eligible, count(*) FILTER (WHERE canonical_artifact AND retention_deadline > clock_timestamp())::integer AS canonical_unexpired, count(*) FILTER (WHERE conversation_channel IS DISTINCT FROM 'voice')::integer AS non_voice_or_missing_parent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE conversation_channel = 'voice' AND organization_id IS NULL)::integer AS voice_parent_missing_organization, count(*) FILTER (WHERE metadata_channel IS DISTINCT FROM 'voice')::integer AS non_voice_metadata, count(*) FILTER (WHERE artifact_source IS NULL OR artifact_source NOT IN ('controller','end_of_call'))::integer AS disallowed_or_missing_source, count(*) FILTER (WHERE provider_call_id IS DISTINCT FROM session_token)::integer AS provider_session_mismatch, count(*) FILTER (WHERE retention_marker IS NULL)::integer AS null_retention_marker, count(*) FILTER (WHERE retention_marker IS NOT NULL AND NOT marker_is_strict_valid)::integer AS malformed_retention_marker, count(*) FILTER (WHERE role NOT IN ('user','assistant') OR NOT artifact_shape_ok)::integer AS non_artifact_shape FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN marker_is_strict_valid THEN retention_marker::timestamptz ELSE NULL END AS retention_deadline, conversation_channel = 'voice' AND organization_id IS NOT NULL AND role IN ('user','assistant') AND artifact_shape_ok AND metadata_channel = 'voice' AND artifact_source IN ('controller','end_of_call') AND provider_call_id = session_token AND marker_is_strict_valid AS canonical_artifact FROM (SELECT *, retention_marker ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$' AND pg_input_is_valid(retention_marker, 'timestamp with time zone') AS marker_is_strict_valid FROM (SELECT c.channel AS conversation_channel, c.organization_id, c.session_token, m.role, m.content IS NOT NULL AND btrim(m.content) <> '' AND m.tool_name IS NULL AND m.tool_result IS NULL AS artifact_shape_ok, m.ai_metadata ->> 'channel' AS metadata_channel, m.ai_metadata ->> 'source' AS artifact_source, m.ai_metadata ->> 'provider_call_id' AS provider_call_id, m.ai_metadata ->> 'retention_expires_at' AS retention_marker FROM public.chat_messages AS m LEFT JOIN public.chat_conversations AS c ON c.id = m.conversation_id) AS artifact_rows) AS marker_classification) AS classified
